english.note: Use this when pack means applying a pack as medical treatment, such as a hot or cold pack on an arm, rather than for packing a container or sealing an engine joint.

examples.english: If you sprain your wrist, pack it with an ice pack.
examples.traditional: 手腕扭親，就用冰袋敷住佢。
